gaps.title: UPGRADE-004 Multi-Mesh Pressure Drop Non-Monotonicity Masking
gaps.description: Test 11 in UPGRADE-004 checked only distinctness (a !== b && b !== c) rather than enforcing 0 < R < 1. The observed pressure drops (0.0522, 0.0790, 0.0710) had R = -0.2985 (oscillatory), caused by boundary-layer under-resolution on the 8x2x2 mesh.
gaps.remediationAction: Re-characterized multi-mesh convergence to strictly evaluate observed order and flag oscillatory convergence when R < 0. Documented pre-asymptotic mesh limitation.

gaps.title: Poiseuille Benchmark Restricted to Boundary Mass Conservation
gaps.description: Poiseuille verification previously tested only inlet vs outlet mass flow delta, without comparing to the exact Navier-Stokes parabolic velocity profile or analytical pressure gradient.
gaps.remediationAction: Added analytical Navier-Stokes Hagen-Poiseuille formulation and pressure gradient comparison to the qualification suite.

gaps.title: Quarantine of Untested Non-linear Switching and Plasticity Engines
gaps.description: StructuralFemEngine.ts contained simplified analytical beam bending equations with hardcoded dummy residuals. Real FEM solver is in src/engine/fem/. High-frequency RF and plastic hardening must remain explicitly quarantined.
gaps.remediationAction: Formally bound qualification to src/engine/fem/ (FEMCore) and src/engine/engineeringCore/NodalCircuitSolver.ts. Quarantined simplified stubs and unverified non-linear models.
